basics.name: Yuxuan (Vincent) Zhang
basics.label: Incoming Assistant Professor, National University of Singapore
basics.summary: A China-born theoretical quantum scientist, enjoyer of classical music, poetry, and nature. From December 2026, Assistant Professor at the National University of Singapore, jointly appointed in Computer Science and Physics, working towards verifiable and practical quantum advantage.
